note: Each step: open `origin` in the Claude browser pane (request access if asked), then run `script` as the BODY of this wrapper in javascript_tool: window.__out=null;(async()=>{try{ BODY ;window.__out=JSON.stringify(out)}catch(e){window.__out='FATAL '+e.message}})();'started' — then poll with: await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,15000));window.__out||'running' until it returns JSON. Merge each step's `out` object into the target doc (shallow merge, later keys win). Never reword any text; every description is the source's own words. The GDELT step takes about 90 seconds; keep polling. Merge rule for 'disruptions': shallow merge of all its steps, asOf from the first. Merge rule for 'watch': shallow merge of all its steps, asOf from the first; keep the 'errors' arrays concatenated. Merge rule for 'economy': shallow merge; the SEC step's keys go under out.sec = {insider, stakes, mergers, insiderScanned, mergersTotal, stakesTotal}; the Alpha Vantage spec produces out.av.

steps.script: const clean=s=>(s||'').replace(/\[[^\]]*\]/g,'').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim();const firstSentences=(t,n)=>{const m=(t||'').replace(/\s+/g,' ').match(/[^.!?]+[.!?]+(\s|$)/g)||[t||''];return m.slice(0,n).join('').trim()};const today=new Date();const iso=d=>d.toISOString().slice(0,10);const out={asOf:today.toISOString().slice(0,16)+'Z',gdacs:[],who:[],wars:[],elections:[],deaths:[],errors:[]};try{const from=iso(new Date(+today-30*864e5));const g=await (await fetch(`https://www.gdacs.org/gdacsapi/api/events/geteventlist/SEARCH?alertlevel=Orange;Red&fromdate=${from}`)).json();out.gdacs=g.features.map(f=>{const p=f.properties;return [p.eventtype,clean(p.name).slice(0,90),p.alertlevel,(p.fromdate||'').slice(0,10),(p.todate||'').slice(0,10),clean(p.htmldescription).slice(0,220).replace(/^(Red|Orange)\s+/,''),clean(p.severitydata?.severitytext).slice(0,120),p.url?.report,+f.geometry.coordinates[0].toFixed(2),+f.geometry.coordinates[1].toFixed(2)]})}catch(e){out.errors.push('gdacs '+e.message)}try{const w=await (await fetch('https://www.who.int/api/news/diseaseoutbreaknews?sf_culture=en&$top=6&$orderby=PublicationDateAndTime%20desc')).json();out.who=w.value.map(v=>[clean(v.Title),(v.PublicationDateAndTime||'').slice(0,10),firstSentences(clean((v.Summary||v.Overview||'').replace(/<[^>]+>/g,' ')),3).slice(0,600),'https://www.who.int/emergencies/disease-outbreak-news/item'+v.ItemDefaultUrl])}catch(e){out.errors.push('who '+e.message)}try{const h=await (await fetch('https://en.wikipedia.org/api/rest_v1/page/html/List_of_ongoing_armed_conflicts')).text();const doc=new DOMParser().parseFromString(h,'text/html');const T=[...doc.querySelectorAll('table.wikitable')].slice(0,2);for(const [ti,t] of T.entries()){for(const r of [...t.querySelectorAll('tr')].slice(1)){const c=[...r.children];if(c.length<7)continue;const links=[...c[1].querySelectorAll('a[href^="./"]')];if(!links.length)continue;const title=l=>decodeURIComponent(l.getAttribute('href').slice(2).split('#')[0]);const getS=async pg=>{try{const j=await (await fetch('https://en.wikipedia.org/api/rest_v1/page/summary/'+encodeURIComponent(pg))).json();return (j.type==='disambiguation'||/same (term|name)/i.test(j.description||''))?null:j}catch(e){return null}};const rowName=title(links[0]).replace(/_/g,' ').replace(/\s*\((disambiguation)\)/,'');const OV={'Sudanese Civil War':'Sudanese civil war (2023–present)','Congolese Civil War':'Kivu conflict','Terrorism in Iran':'2026 Iran war'};let s=OV[rowName]?await getS(OV[rowName]):null;const shown=s?s.title:rowName;if(!s)s=await getS(title(links[0]));if(!s){const cur=links.find(l=>/present\)/.test(title(l)));if(cur)s=await getS(title(cur));}if(!s){for(const l of links.slice(1,4)){s=await getS(title(l));if(s)break}}if(!s)continue;const locs=[...c[3].querySelectorAll('a')].map(x=>clean(x.textContent)).filter(Boolean);out.wars.push([ti?'minor':'major',shown,clean(c[0].textContent),locs,clean(c[6].textContent),clean(c[5].textContent),clean(s.description),ti?firstSentences(s.extract,1).slice(0,260):firstSentences(s.extract,3).slice(0,560),s.content_urls?.desktop?.page]);}}}catch(e){out.errors.push('wars '+e.message)}try{for(const yr of [today.getUTCFullYear(),today.getUTCFullYear()+1]){const h=await (await fetch(`https://en.wikipedia.org/api/rest_v1/page/html/${yr}_national_electoral_calendar`)).text();const doc=new DOMParser().parseFromString(h,'text/html');for(const h2 of doc.querySelectorAll('h2')){const mo=new Date(clean(h2.textContent)+' 1, '+yr);if(isNaN(mo))continue;let el=h2.closest('section')||h2.parentElement;for(const li of el.querySelectorAll('ul > li')){const txt=clean(li.textContent);const m=txt.match(/^(\d{1,2})(?:[–-]\d{1,2})?\s*(?:[A-Z][a-z]+)?\s*[:–-]?\s*(.*)$/);if(!m)continue;const d=new Date(Date.UTC(yr,mo.getMonth(),+m[1]));const diff=(d-today)/864e5;if(diff<-1||diff>90)continue;for(const sub of (li.querySelector('ul')?[...li.querySelectorAll('li')]:[li])){const t=clean(sub.textContent).replace(/^\d{1,2}[^:]*:\s*/,'').replace(/^\d{1,2}\s+[A-Z][a-z]+\s+/,'');const a=sub.querySelector('a[href^="./"]');if(t&&t.length<160&&!out.elections.some(e=>e[1]===t))out.elections.push([iso(d),t,a?'https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/'+a.getAttribute('href').slice(2):`https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/${yr}_national_electoral_calendar`]);if(!li.querySelector('ul'))break}}}}out.elections.sort((a,b)=>a[0]<b[0]?-1:1);out.elections=out.elections.slice(0,40)}catch(e){out.errors.push('elections '+e.message)}try{const from=iso(new Date(+today-30*864e5)),to=iso(new Date(+today-2*864e5));const q=`SELECT ?p ?pLabel ?pDescription ?dod ?links ?article WHERE { ?p wdt:P31 wd:Q5; p:P570 ?st. ?st ps:P570 ?dod; prov:wasDerivedFrom ?ref. FILTER(?dod >= "${from}T00:00:00Z"^^xsd:dateTime && ?dod <= "${to}T23:59:59Z"^^xsd:dateTime) ?p wikibase:sitelinks ?links. FILTER(?links >= 40) ?article schema:about ?p; schema:isPartOf <https://en.wikipedia.org/>. SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "en". } } ORDER BY DESC(?links) LIMIT 40`;const j=await (await fetch('https://query.wikidata.org/sparql?format=json&query='+encodeURIComponent(q))).json();const seen=new Set();for(const b of j.results.bindings){const id=b.p.value.split('/').pop();if(seen.has(id))continue;seen.add(id);let ext='',nm=b.pLabel.value;try{const s=await (await fetch('https://en.wikipedia.org/api/rest_v1/page/summary/'+b.article.value.split('/wiki/')[1])).json();ext=firstSentences(s.extract,2).slice(0,360);if(/^Q\d+$/.test(nm))nm=s.title}catch(e){}out.deaths.push([nm,clean(b.pDescription?.value),b.dod.value.slice(0,10),+b.links.value,ext,b.article.value]);if(out.deaths.length>=15)break}}catch(e){out.errors.push('deaths '+e.message)}

steps.script: const out={};const g=async p=>{const t=await (await fetch(p)).text();const L=t.trim().split('\n').slice(2).map(l=>l.split(',').map(x=>x.trim())).filter(r=>r.length>3&&!isNaN(+r[3]));const last=L[L.length-1];const yr=last[0];const doy=L.filter(r=>r[0]===yr).length;const byYear={};L.forEach(r=>{(byYear[r[0]]=byYear[r[0]]||[]).push(+r[3])});const sameDay=y=>{const a=byYear[y];return a?a[Math.min(doy-1,a.length-1)]:null};const yrs=Object.keys(byYear).filter(y=>y>=1979&&y<+yr);const avg=yrs.map(sameDay).filter(v=>v!=null);return {date:last.slice(0,3).join('-'),extent:+last[3],sameDay:{y1990:sameDay('1990'),y2000:sameDay('2000'),y2012:sameDay('2012'),y2025:sameDay('2025'),avg1979to2025:+(avg.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)/avg.length).toFixed(2),min:+Math.min(...avg).toFixed(2),minYear:yrs[avg.indexOf(Math.min(...avg))]},series:L.slice(-365).filter((r,i)=>i%5===0).map(r=>[r[0]+'-'+r[1]+'-'+r[2],+r[3]])}};out.seaice={north:await g('N_seaice_extent_daily_v4.0.csv'),south:await g('/NOAA/G02135/south/daily/data/S_seaice_extent_daily_v4.0.csv')}

steps.name: GPSJAM interference cells (H3 hex ids; the page converts them)
steps.script: const out={};const m=(await (await fetch('/data/manifest.csv')).text()).trim().split('\n');const date=m[m.length-1].split(',')[0].trim();const t=await (await fetch(`/data/${date}-h3_4.csv`)).text();const rows=t.trim().split('\n').slice(1).map(l=>l.split(','));const cells=[];let med=0;for(const [hex,g,b] of rows){const n=+g+ +b;if(!(+b>0)||n<5)continue;const p=+b/n;if(p>=0.02&&p<0.10)med++;if(p<0.10)continue;cells.push(hex+':'+g+':'+b)}out.gpsjam={date,totalCells:rows.length,high:cells.length,medium:med,cells}

steps.script: const d=await (await fetch('/sites/default/files/feeds/known_exploited_vulnerabilities.json')).json();const v=d.vulnerabilities.slice().sort((a,b)=>a.dateAdded<b.dateAdded?1:-1);const wk=new Date(Date.now()-7*864e5).toISOString().slice(0,10);const out={kev:{count:d.count,released:d.dateReleased,addedThisWeek:v.filter(x=>x.dateAdded>=wk).length,latest:v.slice(0,8).map(x=>[x.cveID,x.vendorProject,x.product,x.dateAdded,x.shortDescription.slice(0,150),x.knownRansomwareCampaignUse,x.dueDate])}}

steps.name: GDELT disruption headlines (slow: one request every 12 s; wait 20 s after opening the page before starting)
steps.script: await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,20000));const topics=[['cell','"cell service" OR "cellular outage" OR "wireless outage" OR "phone service" OR "911 outage"',/outage|down|disrupt|restor|911|service/i],['internet','"internet outage" OR "internet shutdown" OR "broadband outage" OR "fiber cut"',/outage|shutdown|down|cut|restor/i],['power','"power outage" OR "without power" OR "power restored" OR "grid failure"',/power|outage|blackout|electric/i],['travel','"flights cancelled" OR "flights canceled" OR "ground stop" OR "flight delays" OR "service suspended" OR "travel disruption"',/flight|airport|airline|train|rail|service|travel|cancel|delay/i],['tech','"service outage" OR "major outage" OR "widespread outage" OR "is down for"',/outage|down|disrupt|restor/i]];const news={};for(const [k,q,re] of topics){try{const r=await fetch('/api/v2/doc/doc?query='+encodeURIComponent('('+q+') sourcelang:english')+'&mode=artlist&maxrecords=25&format=json&timespan=48h&sort=datedesc');const t=await r.text();let d;try{d=JSON.parse(t)}catch(e){news[k]=[];news[k+'_error']='HTTP '+r.status;await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,15000));continue}const seen=new Set();news[k]=(d.articles||[]).filter(a=>re.test(a.title)).filter(a=>{const key=a.title.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z]/g,'').slice(0,40);if(seen.has(key))return false;seen.add(key);return true}).slice(0,8).map(a=>[a.title.replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim().slice(0,130),a.domain,a.seendate,a.url,a.sourcecountry])}catch(e){news[k]=[];news[k+'_error']=e.message}await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,12000))}const out={news}

steps.script: {"note": "Not a browser step. Call these Alpha Vantage MCP tools (free tier: 25 calls/day, 1/second \u2014 wait 2 s between calls) and build the object below from the responses. Previews that show only the first two data points are enough: they are the latest and prior values.", "calls": [["TREASURY_YIELD", {"interval": "daily", "maturity": "10year", "datatype": "json"}, "yield10 = {latest:[date,+value], prev:[date,+value]} from data[0], data[1]"], ["FEDERAL_FUNDS_RATE", {"interval": "daily", "datatype": "json"}, "fedFunds = same shape"], ["WTI", {"interval": "daily", "datatype": "json"}, "wti = same shape"], ["GOLD_SILVER_SPOT", {"symbol": "GOLD"}, "gold = {ts:timestamp, price:+price}"], ["GLOBAL_QUOTE", {"symbol": "SPY", "datatype": "json"}, "quotes[0] = ['SPY','S&P 500 ETF', latest trading day, +price, +previous close, +change percent (number), +volume]"], ["GLOBAL_QUOTE", {"symbol": "QQQ", "datatype": "json"}, "quotes[1] = ['QQQ','Nasdaq-100 ETF', ...same]"], ["TOP_GAINERS_LOSERS", {}, "mostActive = most_actively_traded.slice(0,16).map(t=>[ticker,+price,+change_percentage without %,+volume]); mostActiveAsOf = last_updated"], ["REAL_GDP", {"interval": "quarterly", "datatype": "json"}, "gdp = {unit:'billions of dollars, quarterly, not annualized', series: first 9 of data as [date,+value]}"], ["COPPER (Mondays only; otherwise copy commod from the previous economy/latest doc)", {"interval": "monthly", "datatype": "json"}, "commod.copper = {unit:'$ per metric ton', series: first 13 of data as [YYYY-MM,+value rounded 2]}"], ["WHEAT (Mondays only)", {"interval": "monthly", "datatype": "json"}, "commod.wheat = same; commod.asOf = latest month"]], "output": "out.av = {asOf, source:'Alpha Vantage (free tier)', yield10, fedFunds, wti, gold, quotes, gdp, commod, mostActive, mostActiveAsOf}"}
